tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us

tr.td: The patient shows mild anemia (low hemoglobin and hematocrit) and mild leukopenia. Red cell indices are within normal limits, suggesting normocytic, normochromic anemia. Platelet count is normal, but platelet distribution width is elevated, indicating increased variability in platelet size, which may suggest reactive or regenerative changes. Further clinical correlation and follow-up are recommended.
